notes.title: Announcing Station Command!
notes.content:
Respite Games is proud to announce our first game: Station Command!

In a far future corporate dystopia, you’ve been assigned as the new Commander of Gwylio Station.  Your job is simple: restore order to the system and ensure nearby mining operations go unhindered.  Just watch out for pirates, revolting colonies, unionizing workers, rouge VIs, and worst of all, performance reviews.

[b]Design Your Ships:[/b] As Commander, you’ll decide what ships to bring to every mission.  Equip them with a wide variety of equipment or create your own custom items that perfectly match your strategy.  Just make sure you don’t violate too many copyrights.

[b]Manage Your Crew:[/b] A wide cast of characters awaits you and your decisions.  Manage your relationships and crew carefully as your choices will radically change the fate of Gwylio and everyone on it.

[b]Command Your Fleet:[/b] Engage in turn-based combat as you issue tactical commands to your fleet.  Expand your options as both you and your fleet grow in size and ability.  Customize your abilities with special upgrades based on your choices and prove yourself as a Commander.

[b]Salvage Everything:[/b] Every item and ship you defeat can be salvaged and repurposed by your fleet.  Reverse-engineer your foe’s greatest weapons and make them your own.  Equip your ships with salvage equipment to bring home even more loot.  Just make sure you still bring enough gear to actually win fights.

We’re thrilled to show you more in the months to come, so follow and wishlist to learn more!
